name: massets
description: Shared theme store for the android_apps family — palettes, tokens, primitives, living backgrounds and ambient audio, consumed as a git submodule.

scripts.showroom: tsc tools/showroom.ts --outDir .showroom --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node && node .showroom/tools/showroom.js

//devDependencies: Pinned to the SDK 54 versions on purpose. MASSETS must run on both SDK 54 and 57, so it type-checks against the OLDER of the two — anything that exists only on 57 fails here, which is the point.
//peerDependencies: What a consuming app must install. Always with `npx expo install <pkg>` so each app gets versions matching its own SDK — never copy the dev pins above.
